title: Unilever invests €35 million to transform India R&D centres into ‘next-gen’ AI-led hubs
summary: Fresh investment by Unilever in India – one of its ‘most important growth markets’ – will also accelerate innovation across human biology, microbiome science, biotechnology and biomanufacturing

extraction.key_fact: 유니레버가 인도 연구개발 센터를 AI 중심 거점으로 바꾸는 데 투자한다.
